"Few industries build data this carefully."

1:00.

Give pharma credit, sincerely. Walk the line one click per station: a purpose (the SAP) is there when the slide opens; click for the spec (define.xml), the build, QC by double programming, release.

A LEGO set is the same idea: a purpose, instructions, every piece checked.

Fifth click: the dashed station with its question mark, and a soft orange glow that keeps breathing. Leave it hanging. The next slide answers it.
